moments.text: Infrared sensor view over moving cloud: a bright white spot with a fainter dot just above it wanders around the crosshair as cloud streams past.
The bright cloud bank slides out of view at the bottom; darker cloud edges pass behind the spot, which stays left of and below the crosshair.
The background turns to plain, even grey; the spot and its faint companion stay left of the crosshair.
Cloud returns, lighter above and darker below. The spot moves to just above the crosshair, then drops below and left of it.
A dark column of cloud appears; the spot passes in front of it, below and left of the crosshair.
Mottled grey cloud fills the view; the spot stays left of the crosshair to the end.
